title: Invincible Tower TD
description: Command an unstoppable line of elemental towers across tactical chokepoints—chain slow fields with AoE blasts to obliterate massive enemy rushes.
controls: Tap map nodes to build and upgrade towers, manage gold wisely, and unleash hero skills on tough waves.

zh-CN.title: 塔防无敌
zh-CN.description: 爽快割草感策略塔防无敌：合理搭配冰冻减速与范围爆破炮塔，卡准路口火力交叉覆盖，怪潮寸步难行！
zh-CN.controls: 点击路径旁据点建造升级各类炮塔，合理分配金币并释放技能全歼敌军。
